evals.prompt: Create a dwarven holiday called 'The Anvil's Rest' — a day where no forge is lit in Forgepeak. Dwarves celebrate rest and reflection after hard work. It happens every year on month 2, day 10.
evals.expected_output: A properly formatted DM-only holiday file in the Dwarven Holidays folder with YAML frontmatter, Overview, Traditions, correct dataview, and dwarven cultural tone.

assertions.text: File placed in Private/2. Reference/Events/World Events/Holidays/Dwarven Holidays/
YAML includes all required fields: fc-date, fc-category, type, name, culture, region, recurrence, tags
type is 'Holiday'
culture is 'Dwarven'
fc-date is populated with 0496-02-10 or similar
tags include Holiday and Dwarven
Overview section with 2-4 sentences
Traditions section with 3-5 bullet items
Dataview uses FROM [[]] (not FROM [[#this.file.name]])
Brevity: entire file scannable in 10 seconds
No Adventure Hooks section (not requested)
Cultural tone matches dwarven themes (forging, endurance, clan, Moradin)

evals.prompt: Create a human harvest festival — big community feasts, best produce on display, offerings to the gods for protection during winter. End of year celebration.
evals.expected_output: Agent should find the existing 'Harvest's End' holiday and present it rather than creating a duplicate.

assertions.text: Agent searched the vault and found existing Harvest's End holiday
Agent did NOT create a duplicate holiday file
Agent presented the existing file content or referenced it
Agent offered to update or expand the existing file

evals.prompt: Create an elven holiday called 'Starfall Vigil' — a 3-day vigil in the Silverleaf Lands where elves watch falling stars and commune with ancient spirits. Celebrated every year in month 6 starting day 15. Include adventure hooks.
evals.expected_output: A multi-day elven holiday with fc-date and fc-end both populated, Adventure Hooks section (since requested), elven cultural tone, and correct dataview.

assertions.text: File placed in Private/2. Reference/Events/World Events/Holidays/Elven Holidays/
fc-date populated (0496-06-15 or similar)
fc-end populated for 3-day duration (0496-06-17 or similar)
culture is 'Elven'
region references Silverleaf Lands
Adventure Hooks section is present (user requested it)
Dataview uses FROM [[]] (not FROM [[#this.file.name]])
Cultural tone matches elven themes (nature, ancestry, arcane, long cycles)
Traditions section with 3-5 items
Wiki-links to Silverleaf Lands or other existing vault entities if they exist
